Promoter profile

About Signature Properties.

A home is an investment in your family’s comfort, security, and future. Our vision is to create residential spaces that bring together thoughtful planning, contemporary design, and everyday convenience.

Located in the well-connected locality of Bendoorwell, Mangaluru, our residential apartment project is designed to offer residents a balance of convenience, functionality, and modern lifestyle.

Featuring a selection of spacious 2 BHK and 3 BHK apartments across five residential floors, our homes emphasise practical space planning, natural light, ventilation, and an inviting residential environment. Clean architectural lines, elegant balconies, refined finishes and warm wood-finish ceiling details give the façade its contemporary character.

Uncompromising standards

Our Approach to Quality.

Quality at Signature Properties is not an afterthought—it is engineered into every column, conduit, tile joint, and door frame.

  • Structural Superiority

    Robust RCC framed superstructure designed to withstand coastal weather factors, paired with deep subterranean foundation footings and waterproof basement design.

  • Finishing Artistry

    Melamine-polished decorative veneer entrance doors, putty-smoothed ceilings, premium vitrified tiles, and Jaguar bathroom fittings selected for enduring elegance.

  • Utility Reliability

    Continuous dual water supply with borewell and corporation water, rainwater harvesting, reticulated gas line distribution, and soundproof generator power backup.

The vision

“An Address That Reflects Your Signature.”

Lotus Signature was envisioned as an exclusive boutique apartment community—offering just 22 private residences for families who seek tranquility without moving away from the heart of the city.

By restricting the density to only 4 residences per floor across 4 upper levels, each homeowner enjoys corner ventilation, optimal acoustic isolation from neighbours, and direct elevator connectivity to their basement parking.

Discover The Project

Design philosophy

Harmonising Light, Air & Proportion.

The building elevation combines contemporary cubist forms with coastal tropical sensitivity. Deep recessed balconies protect interior spaces from harsh monsoon rains and direct afternoon glare, while inviting the refreshing coastal sea breeze.

Natural granite and vitrified tile flooring in common circulation lobbies create an uncluttered, architectural gallery experience upon arrival.
